name: Flowers
description: Flowers word search puzzles gather garden-bed and florist English for adults and seniors — aster, peony, lavender, camellia, bouquet, bloom and border words — without nursery-chain brands or licensed cartoon blooms. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays fragrant and practical: bud, petal, bee, color and vase vocabulary many gardeners already know. This hub pairs well with Garden and Trees when you want a longer outdoor-plant session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as calm as a cutting bed.
